Many teams now allow AI systems to draft customer-facing messages across support, CRM, and billing workflows. This introduces a specific failure mode:
AI can generate text that constitutes an irreversible business commitment
(refunds, credits, billing changes, contractual promises). Once emitted, the commitment exists. Detection after delivery is irrelevant. This project implements a hard authority boundary. Model

AI systems propose messages.
They do not decide whether those messages are allowed to commit the company. A gateway enforces that decision. AI drafts message ↓
Authority Gateway ↓
Send | Block → Approval Behavior
---------
For each outbound message: Inspect text for commitment signals Classify outcome as reversible or irreversible If reversible → allow If irreversible →

Phantom Guard is a CLI tool that catches "slopsquatting" attacks before they compromise your supply chain. The attack vector: AI assistants hallucinate package names → attackers register those names with malware → developers install malware thinking it's legit. How it works:
1. Checks if packages exist on registries
2. Matches against 10+ AI hallucination patterns
3. Detects typosquats of top 3000 packages
4. Analyzes metadata (age, downloads, maintainers) ```
pip install phantom-guard
phantom-guard validate flask-gpt-helper
# HIGH_RISK: Package not found, matches pattern
``` Performance: Try the live demo: https://matte1782.github.io/phantom_guard/ GitHub: https://github.com/matte1782/phantom_guard

excerpt_i18n.en:
Author: Wu You  Editor: Yu Kuai  
Last December, Shanji held a grand AI glasses launch event at the Shenzhen Futian Convention and Exhibition Center. Founder Zhang Bo stood under the spotlight and boldly declared his ambition to be a sharp outlier in a world dominated by sleek designs. In his hands was Shanji’s first AI glasses, priced at 999 yuan—a figure that shattered industry standards and was dubbed “a price even Lei Jun couldn’t match.” This instantly propelled the power bank brand, venturing into AI glasses for the first time, into the spotlight of the tech world.  

However, after the initial hype, Shanji quickly plunged into a fatal crisis. Frequent Bluetooth connectivity issues with the product turned it from a “price disruptor” into a cautionary industry case. The once-outspoken Zhang Bo and Shanji fell silent, offering no response to public skepticism, ridicule, or even rumors of an impending brand sale. Some dismissed the low-price spectacle as a mere joke, while others saw it as a stark reminder: creating a successful AI glasses product is far more challenging than imagined. Behind Shanji’s silence lay answers that many were curious to uncover.  

That year, delayed shipments of AI glasses were not an isolated incident. Although more players entered the AI glasses arena and the upstream supply chain gradually matured, issues such as production difficulties, subpar user experience, and high return rates continued to plague most industry players. The industry forged ahead through trial and error, but Shanji’s absence left the discussion on AI glasses lacking a vibrant touch.  

It wasn’t until a year later that Shanji re-emerged in the public eye with a new generation of products. At the launch event, Zhang Bo announced the official discontinuation of the A1 project, with no further shipments. Full refunds were issued to all users who had purchased or pre-ordered the Shanji AI Paipai Glasses A1.
excerpt_i18n.es: Autor: Wu You. Editor: Yu Kuai. En diciembre del año pasado, Shanji celebró una gran conferencia de lanzamiento de gafas de IA en el Centro de Convenciones y Exposiciones de Futian, Shenzhen. Bajo los focos, el fundador Zhang Bo declaró en voz alta su intención de ser un elemento afilado y diferente en un mundo dominado por la suavidad. Con las primeras gafas de IA de Shanji en mano, fijó un precio de 999 yuanes, rompiendo el límite inferior de la industria, un precio que "ni Lei Jun podría lograr", lo que convirtió instantáneamente a esta marca de power banks, que incursionaba por primera vez en el campo de las gafas de IA, en el centro de atención del mundo tecnológico. Sin embargo, tras el momento de gloria, Shanji pronto se sumergió en una crisis letal. Los frecuentes fallos de conexión Bluetooth del producto lo transformaron de "revolucionario de precios" en un caso típico de la industria. El otrora ostentoso Zhang Bo y Shanji rápidamente cayeron en el silencio, enfrentando las dudas y burlas del exterior.
